question: What does returning `false` from a `beforeEach` guard do?
explanation: `false` aborts the navigation and keeps the current location.

question: Which hook is the right place to update `document.title`?
explanation: `afterEach` runs once the navigation is confirmed, so the title never reflects a cancelled navigation.

question: Why are guards that call `next()` discouraged in Vue Router 5?
options: They are deprecated (with a runtime warning) and easy to call zero or two times
They only work in the Options API
explanation: Return values express the same intent safely; `next` will be removed in Vue Router 6.

question: A `beforeEnter` guard on `/users/:id` blocks some users. What happens when navigating from `/users/1` to `/users/2`?
options: Only afterEach runs, and it can cancel
explanation: `beforeEnter` only fires when entering the route from a different one; use `onBeforeRouteUpdate` or a global guard for param changes.
